compute_mem_params: compute memory-related generation parameters including cache tokens and prefill tokens for a transformer model
calculate_model_params: calculate model parameter count, per-token activation size, and per-token cache size for a transformer model
round_mem_params: round the cache tokens and prefill tokens in a MemParams dataclass to a specified alignment value
create_mem_params_dataclass: create a MemParams dataclass instance with cache tokens and prefill tokens for memory tuning
review_mem_params: review the MemParams dataclass and its round_to method for memory parameter alignment in distributed generation
